items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: the colonel knew me from my outfit... my colonel, Colonel Pecker. He was our best man

ctx.x: So that was that and Marian and I got married. Had to go back to Paris and oh man, I was going to go back in the front lines again in the 461st AAA. And the colonel knew me from my outfit and he wanted me with his outfit. I was just getting ready to go up there when the chaplain came again. He says, McPartland, fall out. (LAUGHTER). And Marian was there. (LAUGHTER). She had come all the way back from Paris and got me to set things up for our marriage and the Battle of the Bulge is going on, who knows, was it?

So, that's true. And so she set the thing up. But in the mean time they didn't send me up to the front lines, they kept me there in Upon and we stayed there. And then the break through of the Bulge was over and a man came back with another show with Marlena Deitrich as a matter of fact, Marlena Deitrich and set things up with the general, General Jervau and my colonel, Colonel Pecker. He was our best man and we got married
